name: Switch
description: Route data to different outputs based on a value match.

properties.name: inputField
properties.description: The value to evaluate against the routing rules

properties.name: routingRules
properties.description: Define routing rules to direct data flow. First matching rule wins.

fields.name: output
fields.description: Name of the output port to route to when this rule matches

fields.name: operator
fields.description: Comparison operator to use for this rule

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value to compare against. Can use {{data.field}}
